dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, sometimes I lose my motivation.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, ˈsʌmtaɪmz aɪ ˈluːz maɪ ˌmoʊtəˈveɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That happens to everyone. Learning a language needs a lot of patience.
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈhæpənz tu ˈɛvriwʌn. ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˈniːdz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈpeɪʃəns.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But I put a lot of effort into it, and I still make mistakes.
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈpʊt ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈɛfərt ˈɪntuː ɪt, ənd aɪ ˈstɪl ˈmeɪk mɪˈsteɪks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The more you practice, the better you'll get.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈmɔːr juː ˈpræktɪs, ðə ˈbɛtər juːl ˈɡɛt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And the more I speak, the more confidence I'll have?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈmɔːr aɪ ˈspiːk, ðə ˈmɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdəns aɪl ˈhæv?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. And the more confidence you have, the easier it gets.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ənd ðə ˈmɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdəns juː ˈhæv, ði ˈiːziər ɪt ˈɡɛts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I see. So the earlier I start, the better.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. soʊ ði ˈɜːrliər aɪ ˈstɑːrt, ðə ˈbɛtər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then I'll practice with Emma every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈpræktɪs wɪð ˈɛmə ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. The harder you work, the faster you'll improve.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ðə ˈhɑːrdər juː ˈwɜːrk, ðə ˈfæstər juːl ɪmˈpruːv.
